{{short description|Indian geneticist and plant breeder (born 1938)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2018}}
{{Use Indian English|date=April 2018}}
'''Surinder Vasal''' is an Indian geneticist and plant breeder, known for his contributions in developing a maize variety with higher content of usable protein.<ref name="CBTNews Features">{{cite web | url=https://www.isaaa.org/kc/cropbiotechupdate/features/vassalvillegas.htm |title= CBTNews Features |publisher=ISAAA.or |date= 2016 | accessdate=6 May 2016}}</ref> He was born on 12 April 1938 in [[Amritsar]] in the Indian state of [[Punjab, India|Punjab]] and received a PhD in genetics and plant breeding.<ref name="Foreign Fellow">{{cite web | url=http://naasindia.org/fdetail.html#V007 | title=Foreign Fellow | publisher=National Academy of Agricultural Sciences | date=2016 | accessdate=6 May 2016}}</ref>

He worked with biochemist [[Evangelina Villegas]] for 35 years to develop a protein enriched form of maize in the 1970s.<ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.isaaa.org/kc/cropbiotechupdate/features/vassalvillegas.htm |title=Dr. Surinder Vasal and Dr. Evangelina Villegas |publisher= ISAAA |date= |accessdate=2012-05-12}}</ref> [[Quality Protein Maize]] is created by adding protein to low nutrient corn and is prevalent in China, Mexico, parts of Central America, and Africa today and is referenced as "miracle maize" because of its role in alleviating malnourishment. In addition to improving the nutritional value of maize, its productivity was also increased. They were jointly awarded the [[World Food Prize]] in 2000 for their development of Quality Protein Maize at the [[International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center]] in Mexico.<ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.agbioworld.org/newsletter_wm/index.php?caseid=archive&newsid=725 |title= "Nobel Prize for Food": World Food Prize to Maize |publisher= AgBioWorld |date= 2000-09-06 |accessdate= 2012-05-12}}</ref>

Vasal is an elected fellow of the [[National Academy of Agricultural Sciences]].<ref name="Foreign Fellow" />

In January 2025, he was honored with the [[Padma Shri]], India's fourth-highest civilian award, by the [[Government of India]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Padma Award Winners 2025 Full List: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri |url=https://www.brutimes.com/news/social/padma-awards-2025-arijit-singh-ajith-kumar-shekhar-kapur-and-late-pankaj-udhas-honored-for-excellence |website=Bru Times News |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Padma Awards 2025 announced |url=https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2096285 |website=pib.gov.in}}</ref>
